subject: Clarify title conversion for L5 candidate (IC vs manager) — scope & headcount impact
messages:
From: Sophie Martin <sophie@greenglass.ai>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 21 Jun 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Candidate: Clara Wu — title recommendation question

Hi Karthik,

Thanks again for taking a look at Clara's resume (attached). She's currently interviewing with the infra team and the interview loop went well — scored particularly strong on system design and people mentoring examples. The hiring manager is leaning toward a people-lead role but wanted to check title/level fit with you before we surface an offer.

Quick context:
- Clara has 8 years total, ~3 years as an IC lead mentoring 3–4 engineers and running design reviews.
- The team would expect her to run a small platform squad (3 ICs + 1 contractor) if she accepts manager title.
- Budget target: $180–210k base + 0.15–0.30% equity range.

Can you confirm whether we recommend offering Manager (L5 manager-track) vs Senior IC (L5 senior IC) for this role? Also if manager, do we need an HC reclassification or is the current HC allocation sufficient?

Attached: Clara_Wu_Resume.pdf

Appreciate a quick read — will loop the hiring manager after your note.

Best,
Sophie Martin
Talent Partner | GreenGlass AI

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
Cc: Sophie Martin <sophie@greenglass.ai>
Date: Sun, 21 Jun 2026 11:04:00 -0700
Subject: RE: Candidate: Clara Wu — title recommendation question

Thanks Sophie — forwarded for calibration.

Team, quick read and recommendation from my side below. I reviewed Clara's resume and the interview notes (linked in related_links). Short answer: I recommend offering L5 but explicitly as a Manager-track title (People Lead) with a conditional scope clause. Rationale:

- Scope: expected team size (3 ICs + contractor) is within our typical L5 manager scope for a first-time manager.
- Experience: Clara has repeat mentoring and concrete examples of running project plans and stakeholder communication. Not yet Staff-level scope.
- Risk: if we label her as Manager and the role grows quickly (-> 6+ reports), we should provide a checkpoint at 6 months for re-eval and potential uplift.

Proposed offer structure:
- Title: Senior Software Engineer (Manager) — internal title mapped to L5 (Manager-track)
- Base: $190k–200k (target midpoint $195k)
- Equity: 0.20% recommended (with standard vesting)
- Manager probation check at 6 months tied to scope/HC update if direct reports >4

HC impact: current HC for the req is labeled as "SWE L5" generic. If we proceed with Manager title, we do not need to change the HC headcount bucket but we should tag it manager-track in HC tracker for reporting. If hiring needs a dedicated Manager HC slot for org planning, we can convert at headcount review — not blocking.

Attachments: comp_parity_6.21.xlsx (quick comp comparators I pulled).

Happy to run this by Compensation if you want a formal review; otherwise propose we sign off and proceed to verbal with Clara tomorrow (Mon).

-Karthik
Karthik Iyer
Sr. Manager, Talent Partners | Redwood Inference

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>, Sophie Martin <sophie@greenglass.ai>
Date: Mon, 22 Jun 2026 09:28:00 -0700
Subject: RE: Candidate: Clara Wu — title recommendation question

Appreciate the write-up Karthik — solid lean. A few clarifying questions before I sign off:

1) Can you add two internal comparators (names/IDs) at L5 manager we recently hired in infra for salary parity? I want to ensure equity bands are consistent.
2) Is the proposed $195k midpoint inside the current comp band for L5 manager in this region or will this be an exception? (If exception required, I need a short approval note for finance).
3) If we mark as manager-track, please confirm we have an updated role description (attach mgr_role_description_v2.docx).

Sophie — if you can confirm Clara's notice period and any competing offers timeline that helps urgency.

If answers are straightforward I can greenlight a verbal and then we run the formal packet through Comp for final sign-off.

Thanks,
Marissa
Director, Recruiting Operations | Redwood Inference

From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 24 Jun 2026 16:03:00 -0700
Subject: RE: Candidate: Clara Wu — title recommendation question

Looping back after a quick comp check with Compensation and a look at HC tracker. Summary and decision:

- Compensation: $195k base + 0.20% equity is within allowable band for L5 manager in US West given experience — no exception needed.
- HC: keep current L5 headcount, tag as manager-track in the tracker. No additional HC required today.
- Offer: proceed with Manager title. Please include a 6-month performance checkpoint that explicitly states scope thresholds for promotion consideration (i.e., when direct reports exceed 4 or ownership expands materially).

Marissa: please coordinate the verbal offer and coordinate with Finance to confirm final gross-to-net. Sophie: aim to get Clara a verbal tomorrow (Fri) if possible. Karthik: update the HC tracker entry (link in related_links) to reflect manager-tag and attach role description.

Thanks everyone — solid cross-team alignment.

Laura Bennett
VP, Talent | Redwood Inference
